title: PATCH /api/notifications/:nid/snooze — snooze notification until date
description: Snooze a notification until a specified date/time. Snoozed notifications are hidden from the notification center until the snooze expires.
acceptanceCriteria: PATCH /api/notifications/:nid/snooze accepts { snoozeUntil: ISO datetime string }
snoozeUntil must be in the future

steps.details: PATCH /:nid/snooze: Validate { snoozeUntil: z.string().datetime() }. Verify snoozeUntil > NOW() (return 400 if not). Find notification by id AND user_id. Set snoozed_until = new Date(snoozeUntil). Return 200.
Snooze notification for 1 hour. GET notifications — verify it's excluded. Try snooze with past date — expect 400.
